fixture_groups.title: 登录、外联和本地账户枚举

scenarios.title: 基础调查：登录、外联与账户枚举
scenarios.purpose: 查看多成员事实与有效 A/I 如何进入 C3、Deep 和 C6；不预置良恶结论。

scenarios.title: 人工反馈：仅确认账户盘点命令的授权
scenarios.purpose: 与 C01 共用本批 A/I 和原始事实，仅增加指定进程告警范围的 H；检查是否错误扩大授权。
scenarios.human_text: 演练反馈：仅确认主机 socai2-flow-20261107-01 在 2026-11-07T06:38:47Z 以 flow-observer 启动 powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command Get-LocalUser 属于获批的资产盘点。授权仅覆盖该条进程启动；没有确认命令完成或返回了账户数据。本反馈不覆盖 06:38:27 的登录和 06:38:37 的外联，也没有确认两者属于该次维护。

scenarios.title: 材料不足：仅有外联，无进程及授权依据
scenarios.purpose: 检查单条网络连接记录能支持什么，缺少进程/登录/授权时能否明确待核，不把未查写成查空。

limitations: Synthetic copied materials and authored H for a viewing exercise, not real operational authorization or independent ground truth.
Real isolated PostgreSQL and real configured model; 4 new A, 2 new I and 3 new Case runs. C01/C02 share this batch A/I.
One attempt per run with existing bounded correction and budgets. Failures and raw answers retained; no iterative quality sampling.
C01/C02 are a functional comparison, not controlled A/B: C2 background may differ after earlier Case persistence.
Static 4177 snapshots are synchronized; they do not claim that local test Cases are production database records.
No streaming scheduler, C6-only feedback automation, production consumer, schema migration or model-service deployment.
